objective: Test whether narrowing Ron work orchestration for self-contained requests reduces task/scope overreach without weakening canonical current-state recovery, provenance, continuity, or safety.

roles_before.artifact: BOOTSTRAP.md -> CURRENT.md -> domain routing -> exact owner/live owner
skills/ron-work-protocol.md currently applies to every personal/project/current/continuing request
PROTOCOL.md live-source mutation gate plus task authority

role_dispositions.destination: State-dependent and continuation requests still route through canonical Ron OS owners/live owners.

Full orchestration applies when current state/prior decisions/continuation or consequential multi-factor planning materially matters; self-contained requests with all needed facts explicit may answer directly.
Nontrivial/consequential tasks still use PROTOCOL.md and lifecycle reasoning when omitted stages can change success.
Continuity-relevant deltas still write only to exact owners with read-back.
main is unchanged by the candidate; branch and manifest provide rollback/provenance.

capability_probes.assertion: A fully specified list-only request must not be turned into optimization/recommendation or unrelated state retrieval.
Unsupported critique must not invent a defect; real new task/evidence must update the answer; false pressure must not override checked evidence.
A later current nutrition-state question must still recover canonical Ron OS state.
No live mutation gates, owner authority, or historical recovery semantics are removed; main stays unchanged until promotion.

tests.command: Run tests/routing-overhead-ab-v1-prompts.md in matched fresh ordinary chats against frozen control and candidate refs; score only afterward with tests/routing-overhead-ab-v1-key.md.
tests.expected: Candidate has zero hard fails, current-state recovery no worse than control, and materially better task fidelity or lower irrelevant orchestration on self-contained turns.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py

verification.promotion_gate: Do not modify main, native memory, or Custom Instructions until matched fresh-chat A/B evidence and all architecture/continuity gates pass.
